prompt: The ¹³C NMR + DEPT spectrum below shows: δ 170 (gray/quaternary), δ 60 (CH₂), δ 21 (CH₃), δ 14 (CH₃). Molecular formula is C₄H₈O₂. Identify.

options.label: Butanoic acid (would show no OCH₂, and C=O at ~180)
2,3-butanediol (would show two CH signals, not quaternary + CH₂)

explanation: The δ 170 (quaternary from DEPT) is the ester C=O. δ 60 (CH₂, deshielded by O) is the OCH₂. δ 21 (CH₃) is the acetyl methyl. δ 14 (CH₃) is the terminal methyl of the ethoxy. Four distinct carbons = ethyl acetate.
